title: Direct amidinium-phosphate interactions guide AT-selective DNA binding by a potent antileishmanial drug.
authors: Nue-Martinez, Jorge Jonathan; Ugedo, Cristina; Lagartera, Laura; Cumella, Jose; Dardonville, Christophe; Garavis, Miguel
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR和约束分子动力学模拟解析了抗利什曼药物JNII40与AT富集DNA小沟的直接脒-磷酸互作机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的药物-DNA结合研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: Neglected tropical diseases caused by kinetoplastid parasites remain a major global health challenge, with current chemotherapies offering limited efficacy and safety. JNII40 is a promising bis(pyridine-2-carboxamidine) ligand with potent antiparasitic activity and selectivity in vivo against Leishmania parasites. The compound specifically targets AT-rich regions of DNA, predominant in the mitochondrion of these parasites. We used NMR spectroscopy to determine the high-resolution structure of a DNA duplex containing four consecutive AT repeats in complex with JNII40. The structure reveals that JNII40 binds deeply into the DNA minor groove through a network of direct and water-mediated hydrogen bonds, including direct interactions between amidine protons and DNA phosphate oxygens. These contacts, supported by extensive intermolecular NOEs, explain the high affinity and sequence selectivity toward AT-rich regions observed by calorimetry and NMR. Restrained molecular dynamics simulations highlight the critical role of two ordered water molecules that bridge the ligand and DNA, preserving the geometry of the complex. Ligand insertion induces a noticeable narrowing of the minor groove. Altogether, these findings provide a structural framework for the rational drug design of selective DNA-targeting molecules against kinetoplastid parasites such as Leishmania.
abstract_zh: 由动质体寄生虫引起的被忽视热带疾病仍然是全球重大健康挑战，现有化疗药物的疗效和安全性有限。JNII40是一种有前景的双（吡啶-2-甲脒）配体，在体内对利什曼原虫具有强效抗寄生虫活性和选择性。该化合物特异性靶向DNA的AT富集区域，这些区域在这些寄生虫的线粒体中占主导地位。我们使用核磁共振波谱法（NMR spectroscopy）测定了含有四个连续AT重复序列的DNA双链体与JNII40复合物的高分辨率结构。结构显示，JNII40通过直接和水介导的氢键网络深入结合到DNA小沟中，包括脒质子与DNA磷酸氧之间的直接相互作用。这些接触，由广泛的分子间NOEs支持，解释了通过量热法和NMR观察到的对AT富集区域的高亲和力和序列选择性。约束分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟强调了两个有序水分子在桥接配体和DNA中的关键作用，保持了复合物的几何结构。配体插入引起小沟的显著变窄。总体而言，这些发现为针对动质体寄生虫（如利什曼原虫）的选择性DNA靶向分子的合理药物设计提供了结构框架。
